title: Statistical analysis report and R code for: Heterogeneous cell cycle dynamics of rat pancreatic beta-cells revealed by induced proliferation
description:
This repository contains the R/Quarto statistical analysis code and rendered statistical report accompanying the manuscript Heterogeneous cell cycle dynamics of rat pancreatic beta-cells revealed by induced proliferation.

The repository includes code for data processing, visualization, linear mixed-effects modelling, model diagnostics, omnibus tests, pairwise comparisons, and generation of the statistical report. No raw or individual-level data are included in this repository; the data used for the analyses are provided as supplementary/source data with the manuscript.

Original GitHub repository: https://github.com/filip-tichanek/beta_cells. Rendered statistical report: https://filip-tichanek.github.io/beta_cells/.
